items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 207:1
items.html: The ascent of the Mincha of Shabbat is like the second aspect, before the sin, when ZA is in the place of AA and the Nukva in the place of AVI, and BYA in the place of YESHSUT and ZON of Atzilut, except for the six lower ones of Assiyah, which are in the six first ones of Beriah. (Item 100).
